title: The 3 Best Vacuums for Brick Floors
excerpt: Discover the top 3 vacuums for cleaning brick floors. Learn everything you need to know about them and find the one that's best for your home.

content.html:
I have been in the field of home automation for quite some time now and have had the opportunity to test and review a wide range of robot vacuums.

And I must say, the market has come a long way in terms of technology and functionality.

If you are looking for the best robot vacuums for brick floors, you have come to the right place! 

In a hurry, check out our top picks below!

With years of experience and in-depth knowledge of the industry, I am confident that I can guide you in finding the perfect robot vacuum to suit your needs. Let's get started!

#1. Option for Brick Floors - Roborock S7 MaxV Ultra

Editor’s Choice

The Roborock S7 is one of the smartest robot mopping and vacuuming combos in the market. It provides an extremely convenient, totally hands-free cleaning experience. Using the Empty Wash Fill Dock, you get automatic dust emptying, mop washing, and robot water tank refilling. The dock even cleans itself too. The powerful suction can pull debris out from in between grout lines from brick, tile, and more.

Check Price on Amazon

What We Like: 

The most impressive feature that I like the most about Roborock S7 MaxV Ultra in context to brick flooring is its brush system.

While using a robot vacuum for brick floors, the type of brushes used by the robot vacuum is a crucial consideration.

The Roborock robot vacuum has a unique brush system that helps to clean brick flooring effectively.

The Multi-plane floating all-rubber roller system allows the brush to stay close to the floor even on uneven surfaces, which results in better cleaning performance. This means that the dirt, dust, and debris will be agitated and picked up more effectively, providing a thorough clean for your brick flooring.

Some robot vacuums have advanced filtration systems that can remove allergens and other microscopic particles that affect air quality, which will help protect your respiratory system.

It's also worth mentioning that all of the robot vacuums listed in this guide have self-emptying, self-refilling, and auto-mop washing capabilities, which is an added advantage over other robot vacuums on the market.

What We Don’t Like:

The only drawback we encountered with the Roborock is its cost. It is among the priciest robot vacuums in the market, but if you're looking for a top-notch cleaning solution, it could be a worthwhile investment.

#2. Option for Brick Floors - Ecovacs Deebot X1 Omni

Runner Up

All-IN-ONE OMNI STATION. A first in the industry. After vacuuming, your DEEBOT returns to the station and automatically empties the dustbin. After mopping, it automatically washes the mop heads and dries them with hot air. Experience a whole new level of freedom from cleaning. The powerful suction can pull debris out from in between grout lines from brick, tile, and more.

Check Price on Amazon

What We Like: 

The Ecovacs Deebot is another great option for those who are looking for a robot vacuum for their brick flooring.

The robot vacuum features Dual Side Brushes and a Floating Main Brush, providing an added level of cleaning efficiency. This combination allows for a more thorough clean as dirt and debris are being moved from all sides and then lifted up into the vacuum for disposal.

Ecovacs robot vacuum has a number of similar features to the Roborock vacuum discussed earlier, but there are a few key differences that set it apart.

One such difference is its large dust bin capacity of 3 liters, which means you won't have to empty it as often as you might with other robot vacuums. This is a convenient feature that can save you time and effort.

The average person spends 100-150 hours per year cleaning the floors in their home.

Another highlight of the Ecovacs Deebot is its high suction power of 5000 Pa, which helps ensure that dirt and debris are thoroughly removed from the floor. This makes it a great choice for those who want to ensure a deep clean every time they use their robot vacuum.

The robot vacuum also has a decent battery life of more than 2 hours, which means it can clean your home without needing to be recharged too often.

The Ecovacs Deebot also uses laser-based navigation technology to effectively navigate your home and avoid obstacles. This technology helps the vacuum move more efficiently, so it can clean your home more quickly and effectively.

All in all, the Ecovacs Deebot is a great choice for those who are looking for a robot vacuum for their brick flooring and want a combination of convenience, performance, and value.

What We Don’t Like:

The charging station of this robot vacuum may appear a bit bigger, which can consume some space and be noticeable in the area. However, its design is straightforward and elegant, blending in with the décor of any room seamlessly.

Fully Automated Cleaning: Automatic dust collection, mop-cleaning and -drying, water-refilling, solution-adding, fast mapping, and path-planning all combine to make fully automated home cleaning a reality. The convenient auto-empty system utilizes our exclusive DualBoost 2.0 system to blow air into the robot’s dust box and vacuum it into a 3L dust bag, giving you up to 60 days of automatic, hands-off cleaning. The powerful suction can pull debris out from in between grout lines from brick, tile, and more.

What We Like:

The Dreametech L10s Ultra boasts a cutting-edge rubber brush, designed to tackle carpet cleaning with ease. The brush's unique design minimizes the risk of getting tangled with hair, ensuring a more efficient and effective cleaning process.

The powerful rubber bristles work in harmony to remove dirt, dust, and hair from your floors and carpets. Additionally, the robot vacuum is powered by one of the highest – 5300 Pa of suction that further enhances the cleaning experience and ensures a thorough clean every time.

What We Don’t Like:

The Dreametech L10s Ultra is a great robot vacuum that has many impressive features, but it may occasionally get stuck on obstacles. This can cause a brief interruption in its ability to return to the base. Although this issue is rare, there is still room for improvement in future updates.

Overall, the Dreametech L10s Ultra is a good choice for those who are looking for a robot vacuum with strong suction and a battery that lasts a long time.

Factors To Consider When Buying Robot vacuum For Brick Floors

Suction Power:

It is important to choose a robot vacuum with strong suction power to effectively pick up dirt, debris and crumbs from the surface of the brick floor.

Brush System:

A robot vacuum with a brush system designed specifically for brick floors can help agitate and lift dirt and debris for better cleaning results.

Robot vacuums have become so popular that some people even give them names and consider them as part of the family!

Dirt Collection System:

A robot vacuum with a large dirt collection system or one that is easy to empty will make maintenance and cleaning easier.

Battery Life:

Consider the battery life of the robot vacuum, especially if you have a large area of brick flooring to clean. A long battery life will allow the vacuum to clean your entire floor without interruption.

Navigation System:

A robot vacuum with a good navigation system will allow it to maneuver effectively around obstacles and clean hard-to-reach areas of your brick floor.

Price:

Robot vacuums can range in price from affordable to high-end. Consider your budget and the features you need in a vacuum to find one that fits your needs and budget.

Benefits Of Using Robot Vacuums For Brick Floors

Effective cleaning:

Robot vacuums are designed to clean floors thoroughly. They use suction and brushes to pick up crumbs, dirt, and other debris, and can be adjusted to different types of flooring. With a robot vacuum, you'll have a spotless floor every day.

If you've used high-quality grout in your brick flooring's joints, there's a lower likelihood of dirt and debris settling in, making it easier for your robot vacuum to clean everything up and leave the floor spotless.

Convenience:

One of the biggest benefits of using a robot vacuum is that it saves you time and effort. You can set it up to run every morning and it will clean your floor while you're doing other things. No more manual sweeping or mopping!

Maintenance of flooring:

A robot vacuum can help maintain the appearance and texture of your brick flooring. It will keep the surface free of crumbs and dirt, and will help reduce surface absorption that can lead to staining and discoloration.

Better air quality:

A robot vacuum can help improve the air quality in your home by removing dust, dirt, and other particles from the floor. This is especially important if you have allergies or asthma.

Easy to use:

Using a robot vacuum is easy and hassle-free. All you have to do is set it up, turn it on, and let it do its thing. There's no need for manual labor, and you can control it from your smartphone or remote control.

So, these are some of the key benefits of using robot vacuums for brick flooring. Whether you're looking for convenience, effective cleaning, or maintenance of your flooring, a robot vacuum is a great investment.

What is The Disadvantage of Brick Flooring?

Brick flooring can have several disadvantages, including:

  1. Unevenness: Brick floors are often uneven, which can make it difficult to install other types of flooring, such as hardwood or tile. This can also create tripping hazards.
  2. Porosity: Brick is a porous material, which means it can absorb moisture and stains. This can be a problem in areas that are prone to spills or high levels of moisture, such as kitchens or bathrooms.
  3. Durability: While brick is a durable material, it is not indestructible. Over time, it can become worn or cracked, which can be costly to repair or replace.
  4. Maintenance: Brick flooring requires regular maintenance, including cleaning and sealing, to keep it looking its best. Without proper care, it can become stained or discolored.
  5. Coldness: Brick floors can be cold underfoot, especially in the winter months. This can be uncomfortable for some people, and may require the use of area rugs or heating systems to keep the floor warm.

Overall, while brick flooring can be beautiful and add character to a home, it is not without its drawbacks. It's important to weigh these disadvantages against the benefits before deciding whether brick flooring is right for your home.
